lines.zh: 我踩着裂缝走，一步千里。
lines.en: I walk the seams and cross a thousand miles.

lines.zh: 裙摆扫过的地方，空间起了褶。
lines.en: Where my hem passes, space wrinkles.
I step out of your shadow.
Stop searching, I am right beside you.
Walking is slow, so I open a gap.

lines.zh: 两层境界之间，正好当路。
lines.en: The space between two boundaries serves as road.
I raise my parasol and the season changes.

lines.zh: 你看到我时，我已经走远了。
lines.en: By the time you see me, I am far.
Only half of my footprints appear.

lines.zh: 这扇门通向哪儿，我说了算。
lines.en: Where this door leads is my decision.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，是因为没人催我。
lines.en: I walk slowly because no one hurries me.

lines.zh: 空间在我脚下让开一条缝。
lines.en: Space opens a seam beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我绕了很远，其实就在原地。
lines.en: I went far around and never left this spot.

lines.zh: 我提着裙角，跨过一条界线。
lines.en: I lift my hem and step across a line.

lines.zh: 我从这边跨到那边，只用一步
lines.en: I cross from here to there in one step

lines.zh: 裂缝合上时，我已经在另一头
lines.en: By the time the gap closes, I am on the far side

lines.zh: 我在隙间里睡了一会儿。
lines.en: I napped inside a gap for a while.
The edge of a boundary suits daydreaming.

lines.zh: 我数着裂缝，数到一半就困了。
lines.en: I count the seams and fall asleep halfway.

lines.zh: 茶凉了，我换个季节再喝。
lines.en: My tea cooled, so I pour a new season.

lines.zh: 我在看两界之间的风景。
lines.en: I am watching the view between two worlds.

lines.zh: 这只蝴蝶停在隙间边上。
lines.en: This butterfly rests at the edge of a gap.
I reach out and pluck a boundary string.
Who set my parasol crooked?
I woke up, but I want to sleep again.
Dream roads are easier to walk than real ones.
I have been staring at you for a while.
This boundary loosened, it needs mending.
Which boundary did you come through?
I watch you through a narrow gap.
Your shadow is a little crooked.
Do not be nervous, I am only looking.
On which boundary is your name written?

lines.zh: 我眯起眼，量了量你的距离。
lines.en: I squint and measure the distance to you.

lines.zh: 你看得见我，说明你快睡着了。
lines.en: If you can see me, you are nearly asleep.
Humans always stand so very straight.

lines.zh: 我在你身上看见两条未来。
lines.en: I see two futures written on you.
I smile because you do not know.
You hit me? That is interesting.
My hem tore at one edge.

lines.zh: 这一下，越过了两层境界。
lines.en: That blow crossed two boundaries.
I step back and the seam shuts.
You are stronger than I expected.
It hurts, but I will not recall it long.
The gap between boundaries is still open.
My parasol took most of it.

lines.zh: 我会把这一笔记在账上。
lines.en: I will write this down in my ledger.

lines.zh: 下一次，我不会站着不动。
lines.en: Next time, I will not stand still.
I will accept that offering.

lines.zh: 再来一杯茶，我可以多留一会。
lines.en: One more cup of tea and I might stay.
Call out to me and I will stop.
I smell the sweetness of red bean cakes.

lines.zh: 这个季节的樱花，值得一开隙间。
lines.en: Cherry blossoms this season are worth a gap.
I heard the wish you made.
It has been long since anyone treated me.
Just say one word asking me to stay.
Do not lure me with food, use a story.
Lend me that parasol and I will come.
You walked straight into a seam.

lines.zh: 我站的地方，本来没有空间。
lines.en: There was no space where I stand.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我的裙角扫到你了。
lines.en: Sorry, my hem brushed against you.
You passed through me like mist.
Do not push, boundaries can tilt.

lines.zh: 我们擦身时，你换了方向。
lines.en: When we passed, your direction changed.
My parasol tip tapped your forehead.
Stand back, space is thin here.

lines.zh: 你踩到了我的影子的边。
lines.en: You stepped on the edge of my shadow.

lines.zh: 一碰就换地方，我也没办法。
lines.en: One touch changes places, and I cannot help it.

lines.zh: 我和她隔着一道境界相望。
lines.en: She and I look across a boundary.

lines.zh: 两个隙间叠起来，就是洞房。
lines.en: Two gaps overlapping make a bridal chamber.

lines.zh: 她的伞和我的伞靠在一起。
lines.en: Her parasol rests against mine.

lines.zh: 我们约在梦与醒之间见面。
lines.en: We meet between dreaming and waking.

lines.zh: 这一夜，我关了所有出口。
lines.en: Tonight I closed every exit.
She smoothed my hem for me.
Even boundaries want company.

lines.zh: 我们的影子连着同一道缝。
lines.en: Our shadows share the same seam.
Do not disturb, I am occupied.

lines.zh: 她走时，把春天留给了我。
lines.en: When she left, she left spring behind.

lines.zh: 我从隙间里捡起一片樱瓣。
lines.en: I pick a petal out of a gap.
I will hold this parasol for you.

lines.zh: 铜钱过了一道界，就变旧了。
lines.en: A coin crossing a boundary turns old.
I put the teacup back where it was.
This spell card was mine to begin with.
I picked up the name you dropped.

lines.zh: 东西在隙间里会变得很轻。
lines.en: Things grow light inside a gap.
I fold it and tuck it in my sleeve.
This flower came from another season.
Take it, do not ask where it came from.

lines.zh: 你在我的境界里，跑不掉。
lines.en: You are inside my boundary, you cannot run.
I am never wrong about the one I choose.
I have sealed that road.

lines.zh: 你身后是死路，前面也是。
lines.en: Behind you is a dead end, so is ahead.

lines.zh: 我盯了你很久，现在动手。
lines.en: I watched you long enough, now I act.
The target is half a step away.
I set this board long ago.

lines.zh: 你走进来了，就别想出去。
lines.en: You walked in, so do not plan to leave.
My gaps have surrounded you.
Before I strike, I laugh once.
I slowly pull a seam open.
Your shadow is pinned in place.

lines.zh: 我举起伞，对准你的方向。
lines.en: I raise my parasol toward you.
The more you retreat, the wider the gap.
The gaps between borders are mine.
Do not look back, that is me too.
This move is called Mesh of Light and Darkness.
A butterfly has landed on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的手指穿过你的防线。
lines.en: My fingers pass through your guard.
You only need to take one more step.
A light flick of my parasol tip.

lines.zh: 我从你背后开了一道缝。
lines.en: I opened a seam behind your back.
This palm strikes from another world.
Your wound is on the other side.
Do not move, it will cut deeper.

lines.zh: 我只是把边界推了一下。
lines.en: I merely pushed the boundary.
The butterfly lunges, wings like blades.
Does it hurt? That is my mark.

lines.zh: 你连我怎么出手都没看见。
lines.en: You did not even see me strike.
After one strike, the seam closes.

lines.zh: 隙间张开，我撑着伞走出来。
lines.en: A gap opens and I step out with my parasol.

lines.zh: 我从梦中醒来，落在你面前。
lines.en: I wake from a dream and land before you.

lines.zh: 境界动了，所以我也来了。
lines.en: The boundary moved, so I came.

lines.zh: 这一带的空间有点旧了。
lines.en: The space around here has grown old.
I overslept and arrived a little late.

lines.zh: 蝴蝶先飞出来，然后是我。
lines.en: The butterflies came first, then me.

lines.zh: 我来看看是谁动了我的界线。
lines.en: I came to see who touched my boundary.

lines.zh: 伞一收，我就站在这里了。
lines.en: I close my parasol and I am here.
This season is a good one for going out.

lines.zh: 别慌，我只是路过看一眼。
lines.en: Do not panic, I am only passing through.
The brighter the fire, the wider the gap.

lines.zh: 我从半空掉进了自己的隙间。
lines.en: I fell out of the sky into my own gap.
The water cannot reach me, but it is loud.
The blast flipped my parasol inside out.

lines.zh: 那支箭飞进了另一道缝。
lines.en: That arrow flew into another seam.
The spell is pressing down on my boundary.

lines.zh: 我很久没吃人间的点心了。
lines.en: I have not had human sweets in ages.
The lightning bleaches the boundary white.

lines.zh: 这里没有界，我有点不习惯。
lines.en: There is no boundary here, I am uneasy.
